mission_02: Facebook Prophet is a powerful forecasting procedure designed for business time series that exhibit strong seasonal patterns and multiple changepoints. Unlike ARIMA, which requires manual parameter tuning, Prophet uses an additive model where non-linear trends are fit with yearly, weekly, and daily seasonality components, plus holiday effects. The key innovation is its piecewise linear trend model with automatically detected changepoints, allowing the trend rate to adapt at specific moments in time. In this mission, you will implement the core Prophet mechanics: generating data with trend and seasonality, fitting a piecewise linear trend with changepoint adjustments using least squares, and extending forecasts into the future. This approach is particularly valuable for business forecasting where interpretability and automatic handling of seasonal patterns are essential.
